#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar entry for the project kickoff meeting.

Event: Project Kickoff Meeting
When: Next Monday (the next occurring Monday), 10:00 AM - 12:00 PM local time
Reminder: 15 minutes before
"""
import datetime
import uuid

OUTPUT = "project_kickoff.ics"
SUMMARY = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
DESCRIPTION = "Kickoff meeting for the project: agenda, goals, roles, and next steps."
LOCATION = "TBD"


def next_monday(today: datetime.date) -> datetime.date:
    """Return the next occurring Monday (7 days ahead if today is Monday)."""
    days_ahead = (0 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + datetime.timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def format_event_time(dt: datetime.datetime):
    """Return (formatted_time, tzid_or_None).

    Uses an explicit IANA TZID when available; otherwise falls back to UTC.
    """
    tzinfo = dt.tzinfo
    key = getattr(tzinfo, "key", None)
    if key:
        return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"), key
    return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"), None


def main() -> None:
    now = datetime.datetime.now().astimezone()
    tz = now.tzinfo
    meeting_date = next_monday(now.date())

    start_local = datetime.datetime(
        meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=tz
    )
    end_local = start_local + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)

    uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace-calendar"
    dtstamp = now.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

    start_str, start_tzid = format_event_time(start_local)
    end_str, end_tzid = format_event_time(end_local)
    assert start_tzid == end_tzid, "Start and end must use the same timezone"

    if start_tzid:
        dtstart_line = f"DTSTART;TZID={start_tzid}:{start_str}"
        dtend_line = f"DTEND;TZID={start_tzid}:{end_str}"
    else:
        dtstart_line = f"DTSTART:{start_str}"
        dtend_line = f"DTEND:{end_str}"

    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Project Kickoff//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}",
        dtstart_line,
        dtend_line,
        f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}",
        f"DESCRIPTION:{DESCRIPTION}",
        f"LOCATION:{LOCATION}",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        f"DESCRIPTION:Reminder: {SUMMARY} starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    content = "\r\n".join(lines)

    with open(OUTPUT, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
        f.write(content)

    # --- Validation ---
    assert content.count("BEGIN:VCALENDAR") == 1 and content.count("END:VCALENDAR") == 1
    assert content.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1 and content.count("END:VEVENT") == 1
    assert content.count("BEGIN:VALARM") == 1 and content.count("END:VALARM") == 1
    assert "VERSION:2.0" in content and "PRODID:" in content
    assert "DTSTART" in content and "DTEND" in content and "UID:" in content and "DTSTAMP:" in content
    assert "SUMMARY:" in content and "DESCRIPTION:" in content and "LOCATION:" in content
    assert start_local < end_local, "DTEND must be after DTSTART"
    assert len(uid) > 0 and len(dtstamp) == 16
    assert start_local.hour == 10 and (end_local - start_local) == datetime.timedelta(hours=2)

    tz_label = start_tzid if start_tzid else "UTC"
    print(f"Created: {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Event: {SUMMARY}")
    print(f"Date: {meeting_date.strftime('%A, %B %d, %Y')}")
    print(f"Start: {start_local.strftime('%I:%M %p')} ({tz_label})")
    print(f"End:   {end_local.strftime('%I:%M %p')} ({tz_label})")
    print(f"Duration: 2 hours")
    print(f"Reminder: 15 minutes before start")
    print(f"UID: {uid}")
    print("--- ICS content ---")
    print(content)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
